d: S6730-H48X6C-V2(48*10GE SFP+ ports, 6*40GE QSFP28 ports, optional license for upgrade to 6*100GE QSFP28, without power module)

specs.label: Layer 2 features
specs.value: STP, RSTP, MSTP, Link Aggregation (LACP - IEEE 802.3ad), LLDP / LLDP-MED / CDP, Port mirroring (SPAN), IGMP Snooping

specs.label: Layer 3 features
specs.value: Static routing, RIP, OSPF, EIGRP, Policy-based routing (PBR), IPv4 / IPv6 Dual Stack, OSPF / OSPFv3, BGP, Policy-Based Routing (PBR)

specs.label: Security features
specs.value: 802.1X authentication, MAC authentication bypass, DHCP snooping, Dynamic ARP inspection, IP Source Guard
